content: I'm running Thunderbird v.115.10.1 on a Mac. All of a sudden, I am getting the following error message when I open up TB or check email: "Sending of password for user did not succeed. Mail server pop.earthlink.net responded: Internal error”. If I exit TB and log back in, I usually don't get the error message again and TB downloads incoming emails. I have no problem sending emails.
